_comment_purpose: Schema seed file for testimonial-collector.py. The LIVE store lives at $env:LOCALAPPDATA/grok-agent/creator-program/testimonials.json on the user's Windows machine. This file in the repo is a documentation stub showing the expected JSON shape — it is NEVER read at runtime and does NOT contain real creator data.
_comment_privacy: Real testimonials are consent-gated and stored locally only. Never commit a testimonial with real creator data to this file.

schema.handle: string — X handle without leading @ (max 15 chars)
schema.follower_count: integer | null — optional, used to render '12k followers' in cards
schema.quote: string — the verbatim testimonial (20-600 chars). NEVER edit for tone.
schema.templates_used: array<string> — one or more of the 20 creator template slugs
schema.source: string — one of: dm, x-reply, x-quote-tweet, email, voice-memo, other
schema.linked_outreach_id: string | null — optional OR-NNNN id from outreach.json
schema.consent_to_publish: bool — REQUIRED true to add. False after revoke.
schema.consent_to_attribute: bool — true = use handle, false = anonymize
